newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle barely weaker, off lows.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle barely weaker, off lows.

text.p: NYCE January frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed barely weaker after falling to a lifetime low in early dealings.
Late-session trade buying carried the spot contract off 101.25, its lifetime low, floor sources said.
But trade selling accounted for the bulk of today's volume, estimated at 1,550 lots.
Despite today's positive close, market sources said prices could continue to head lower and pegged support in January at 100.00 amid ample supplies.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture put the Florida crop at 220 million 90-lb boxes in its October estimate, a number the market views as bearish for prices.
January finished off 0.35 at 102.70, having ranged from 104.10 to 101.25. Spot November settled 0.15 lower at 111.50, while the back months ended 0.05 higher to 0.35 lower.
The March contract also traded at a lifetime low, at 104.00.
